description: Proof otherwise verifies, but claims chainKey=3 (Ethereum mainnet, confirmed via ChainInfo in Gate 1 — data/gate1/chain-key.json) instead of the expected chainKey=1 (Sepolia). Must be rejected even though proofVerified is true, because the same Sablier address could in principle be deployed on another chain.
note: Real Gate 1 Sepolia stream (tx 0x9d3a4...80cc8, stream 177), with chainKey deliberately swapped to 3.
